name: Terrassa

routes.outcome: Official national Catastro portal found; public portal advertises the property search and cartographic viewer. No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax/account, or personal fields were requested.
Official Ajuntament de Terrassa IDE GeoPortal identifies municipal geographic services, ArcGIS REST access, ETRS89 as the normal cartographic reference, and the local GIS custodian.
Anonymous ArcGIS REST catalog returned the Cadastre folder and local services.
First-party municipal cadastral MapServer returned parcel layers, EPSG:25831, full extent, and public Query/Data capabilities.
Layer cgc_par is a polygon Feature Layer. Native fields include FID and REFCAD; safe extraction used only REFCAD plus unchanged geometry. Other native fields were not retained.

Exact-point anonymous query using the immutable WUP point in EPSG:4326, intersects, outFields=FID,REFCAD, returnGeometry=true, outSR=4326 returned one parcel: REFCAD 8016615DG1081B, FID 20408, polygon geometry.

Bounded nearby envelope query in EPSG:4326 returned a large anonymous parcel response with IDs, confirming local coverage; it was retained only in ignored scratch evidence and no extra polygons were kept.

schemaAndCrs.viewerConfig: Ajuntament de Terrassa IDE GeoPortal; ArcGIS REST service https://emap.terrassa.cat/arcgis/rest/services/Cadastre/ajt_cadastre/MapServer
schemaAndCrs.geometryCrs: Service native EPSG:25831 (ETRS89 / UTM zone 31N); exact-point response requested as EPSG:4326 for retained GeoJSON.
schemaAndCrs.nativeIdentity: REFCAD is the native cadastral reference field and was used as the sole retained GeoJSON identity. FID was observed as an ArcGIS OID but not retained.

sourceFieldMapping.FID: observed ArcGIS object ID; not retained

schemaAndCrs.compositeKeyProvenance: No composite key used; REFCAD alone was exposed by the official layer and is stable-looking cadastral identity.

boundedAnonymousResponse.requestScope: Exact WUP point plus nearby envelope

qualification.reason: A real first-party local cadastral adapter endpoint and safe anonymous ID-plus-geometry response were evidenced, but runtime/admission remains held pending independent serial review.

scopeLimits: The exact WUP point was preserved and not shifted.
The exact point intersects one parcel in the municipal layer; this does not establish completeness or citywide coverage.
The nearby envelope request was bounded spatially but returned many features; larger unchanged response evidence remains only under ignored tmp/valhalla-parcel-research/5035/.
National Catastro and Generalitat pages are general agency/custodian evidence; the Ajuntament de Terrassa ArcGIS service is the evidenced local registry/cadastre map service.
Only one full parcel polygon is retained, with exactly one canonical native identity in properties.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax/account, certificate, or personal fields were requested or retained.
This packet is not source integration or admission; runtimeReadiness remains held.
uncertainty: The municipal parcel layer is publicly queryable and returned a point-intersecting polygon, but its publication/update cadence and relationship to the national Catastro authoritative dataset were not independently verified. The service can expose additional legacy fields, which were intentionally excluded from the retained sample.
